noArticles.title: Blog has no articles yet
noArticles.description: Statistics will be available after adding the first article

savedTime.title: Estimated time saved
savedTime.tooltip: Estimated from completed AI writing only: generated words ÷ {speed} words per hour. Actual time saved may vary. The money estimate uses {rate} per hour. Research and images are not counted yet.

savedAmount.title: Estimated money saved
savedAmount.legacyTooltip: This historical estimate uses the words in articles currently marked fully AI-written. It is not a record of actual generation and may overlap with newer records, so the two are not added together. Calculated at {speed} words and {rate} per hour.

value.legacyArticleCount: No AI articles | {count} AI article | {count} AI articles
value.seeAllTime: See the historical estimate under All time

savings.tooltip: Estimated from completed AI writing using the current rate of {rate}/h and {speed} words/h. Manual edits and subsequent saves do not add to the total.

topArticle.noViews: No article has been read yet

engagementRate.title: Engagement Rate
engagementRate.tooltip: Engagement shows how actively readers interact with your articles. It is all interactions (likes, comments, shares and poll votes) divided by all views across the blog. A higher value means more engaged readers.

upgradePrompt.title: Unlock Premium Statistics
upgradePrompt.description: Gain deeper insights into your blog's performance with advanced charts, share analysis, engagement rate, and popular tags. Upgrade to PRO or PREMIUM to maximize your potential!

charts.trackingSince: Tracked since {date} — earlier views were not recorded.
